title: What is an agent?

body.text: is an AI that doesn't just answer — it
plans and uses tools on its own, step by step
, to reach a goal: search the web → read results → summarize → save a file. You only give the end goal; you don't direct each step.

example: Goal: 'Find 5 competitors, build a price comparison table, and save it as a file' (the agent does every step itself)

title: Give a clear goal and boundaries

body.text: An agent works well with a
— like 'use this year's data only' or 'never delete files.' The clearer the boundaries, the less the agent goes off track. Always review the result before using it for real.

example: Goal + boundaries: 'Summarize this month's customer reviews, use only in-system data, don't guess beyond it'
